text:
ashley: quick heads-up 1: we observed aggregate token overspend when multiple proxies used the 300ms local cache during a cross-region burst. proxies each consumed cached credits and total exceeded tenant quota.

dmitri: yup, reproduced on staging. race between local cache validity and central ledger reconciling.

kevin: TTL was to cut p99. tradeoff now obvious. Options: reduce TTL, add central lease/refill, or add coordination channel.

maria: proposal: introduce small per-proxy reservoir granted by central quota-service. proxies spend from reservoir at low latency; refill is best-effort. central stays source-of-truth. also add emergency buffer rules.

kevin: API sketch:

```
POST /quota/v1/reservoirs/refill
{ tenant_id: "t-42", proxy_id: "px-9", requested: 50 }
=> { granted: 10, lease_ttl_ms: 400 }
```

Proxies treat granted as authoritative until TTL expires.

lee: policy: if central returns 0 (fast-decline) proxies stop local admissions and fall back to synchronous central check. if central unreachable, use emergency buffer only for premium tenants, otherwise 429.

maria: telemetry: track reservoir_granted_total, reservoir_used_total, reservoir_delta_per_tenant. spike detector alert if sum(local_used)-central_spent > 5% over 1s.

dmitri: security: require mTLS + proxy identity header, idempotency token on refill, rate-limit refill endpoints per-proxy. persist per-proxy ledger for reconciliation.

ops-bot: deploy-note: next canary slot 2025-06-05 09:00 UTC (cluster: canary-3, 6 proxies).

ashley: rollout plan: 1) shadow mode (proxies report decisions but don't act) 2) enable tiny reservoirs (5-20 tokens) 3) strict telemetry + alarm 4) increase gradually. owners: kevin (API proto, 4d), maria (telemetry dashboard, 5d), lee (rollout plan & ops coordination, 3d), dmitri (security checklist, 3d).

kevin: will open RFC draft and proto in gh. ping me to pair.

maria: I'll add dashboard and spike query to the platform prometheus namespace.

lee: will sync with infra for canary window and add rollback playbook.

ashley: thanks all. I'll collate notes into RFC once kevin's draft is up. objections? :thumbsup:
